question.en: Does Rural diesel pump list the same diesel engine power as Diesel 30?
question.zh: 农村柴油泵和柴油30的柴油机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Rural diesel pump lists 17 kW. Diesel 30 lists 4105 / 56 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
